cases.input: ERP cost-centre code changes while finance accountability is unchanged.
cases.expect: Centre identity and version remain; a dated alias binding changes.

cases.input: Ledger scope and accountable position change during reorganization.
cases.expect: A successor centre version becomes effective; historical postings remain pinned to the prior version.

cases.input: One centre splits into two successors.
cases.expect: Lineage records weights or an explicit reconciliation rule and preserves the predecessor.

cases.input: Allocations exceed the released amount from one funding source.
cases.expect: The budget profile rejects the allocation set.

cases.input: An associated organizational unit moves but finance accountability is unchanged.
cases.expect: No new centre identity is minted merely from the organization move.
